label: Figure 1.5: Circular flow of income (five sectors)
alt: Circular flow of income with households and firms, plus government, financial institutions and foreign sector, each with a red leakage arrow out and a teal injection arrow in.
caption: Households and firms exchange expenditure and income (purple loop; the matching real flows of goods and factors are omitted for clarity). Three other sectors connect to the flow: taxes leak out to the government and government spending is injected back; saving leaks out to financial institutions and investment is injected back; spending on imports leaks out to the foreign sector and export revenue is injected back. Leakages and injections need not be equal at any moment.
